// Negative fixture: a connector that re-creates the host-owned multi-user
// authority locally. Connector modules are separate Go modules, so a same-named
// identifier alone would be harmless; the bypass signal is a package-local
// multi-user approval table or eligibility function that a future reader could
// mistake for the host decision.
package fixture

// multiUserEligibilityTable re-creates the host approval registry in a connector.
var multiUserEligibilityTable = map[string]bool{"synthetic-external-connector": true}

// IsApprovedForMultiUser invents a local eligibility decision.
func IsApprovedForMultiUser(kind string) bool { return multiUserEligibilityTable[kind] }
